description: Text-retrieval recall@k: does a chunk from the expected SEC section appear in the top-k retrieved chunks? 12 original cases (why->MD&A, risk->Risk Factors per company) plus 42 template-expanded cases covering Business, Legal Proceedings, Market Risk (7A), MD&A subsections (liquidity, opex, capital return), Controls, and Cybersecurity. Expected sections were written against section labels that exist in the parsed corpus; metric questions are excluded (they are answered from XBRL, covered by metric_accuracy_eval).
